retrieved_evidence.title: Payment portal failure and next working day
retrieved_evidence.text:
If the payment portal fails on the due date, a student may pay on the next working day
without a late charge ONLY if they report the failure to Finance on the original due date
and attach a timestamped screenshot or transaction reference to the official support ticket.
Working days are Monday through Friday excluding institute holidays. The agent has no
institute holiday calendar and must not guess the exact next working date. If the report
was late or supporting evidence is missing, Finance must decide; an extension is not guaranteed.
The chat demo can create a ticket but does not upload attachments: submit evidence through Finance.

retrieved_evidence.title: Late payment penalties
retrieved_evidence.text:
A late payment charge of INR 500 applies for each working day after the due date that a
balance remains unpaid, up to a maximum of INR 5,000 per term. The charge does not apply
when the PAYMENT-02 portal-failure conditions are met. Finance may waive the charge only
through a finance support request; the agent cannot waive or promise a waiver.
Unpaid balances 30 calendar days after the due date place a hold on examination registration.

- Fees, balances, due dates and late payment rules
- Scholarship status and eligibility
- Academic rules: attendance, electives and programme changes
- Support tickets: raising, tracking and escalation
- Your registered email and remembered preferences

Ask me about any of these, or raise a support ticket if you need a person.
